briefdescription.para: Wave D — Document High-Cardinality Stress Tests.

detaileddescription.para: Stress tests for the document store module covering high-cardinality scenarios: 1500 distinct document keys, 8-thread concurrent CRUD, schema-version churn, and merge conflict detection under load.
These tests are excluded from the fast release_critical gate and are intended for Wave D stress validation pipelines.

listitem.para: MergeConflictUnderLoad — merge stability under concurrent writes
